# ex: compositeLitNeedsParen TypeAssertExpr case (ex.go:841-844)
# A composite literal used as the expression (X) of a type assertion
# inside an if condition. The type assertion encloses the composite literal
# so the assertion parens prevent ambiguity.

ex {
	A -> B
}

type B struct{ X int }

type I interface{}

func f() {
	if A{1}.(I) != nil {
	}
}
